limitations: The evidence channel is deliberately ordinal. The realized utility of a delivered artifact is a linear equation in the goal weights, so an arm that observed it could solve for the goal in four generations; that would measure linear algebra, not learning.

Learning happens only from generations in which the consensus actually changed, so the post-change evidence rate is a few observations, not one per generation. The belief_error block is what makes a null result readable.
The defect channel is disarmed. E027 and E028 cover it.
The oracle-reset variant is an upper bound, not a design: it is told for free exactly when the goal moved.
One landscape, one substitute goal, one filter family. A different belief representation could behave differently.
